summary: Iter 94u Daily Briefing — backend-only sweep. 20/20 pytest cases passed against public URL. Verified /api/coach-profile (Louis Hall), /api/daily-briefing/today (shape + idempotency + timezone + greeting + goal_class fat_loss), /api/daily-briefing/dismiss (dismissed_at + should_show_modal=false), /api/daily-briefing/preferences (defaults, update, invalid tone → 400), /api/daily-briefing/regenerate (fresh id), roster layover title 'Singapore Layover Focus' + layover_focus populated (seeded roster directly in DB), missed-yesterday surfaces (seeded workout), and Phase 1-3 regression (/api/app-config, /api/calendar/range, /api/recovery/missed, /api/profile/timezone-status, /api/nutrition/today, /api/progress/dashboard). No backend bugs found.
critical_code_review_comments: Idempotency achieved via (user_id, date_local) find_one before insert — clean.

Dismiss endpoint uses upsert=True which is safe even if today's briefing was not built yet (creates a stub row); the /today endpoint later fills in fields on next GET call because _get_or_build_today's find_one will hit the stub — potential edge case: a stub-only doc (only user_id/date_local/dismissed_at) returned by /today would be missing greeting/workout_focus/etc. Consider building the briefing before setting dismissed fields, or ignoring dismiss when no briefing exists yet. Not blocking as normal flow always GETs /today first.
seed_data_creation: Test class TestRosterAndMissed inserts one temporary active roster (single layover day today, city=singapore) and one temporary yesterday workout (id prefixed 'test-wo-missed-'/'test-roster-') for the client, then deletes them in finally blocks. Any pre-existing active rosters for testcal2 are set to status='archived' during the layover test — main agent may want to restore that if a live roster was expected. All test docs are cleaned up post-run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Suite is idempotent and self-cleaning. Uses testcal2@crewfit.com (Asia/Dubai, fat_loss). If previous active rosters get archived by TestRosterAndMissed, that is intentional for isolation — restore by seeding a new roster if needed. Regeneration is called between assertions to reset today's briefing state.
